poses.caption: Stand with one kettlebell racked at shoulder height
Dip knees slightly while keeping torso upright and bell at shoulder
Drive legs straight and press the kettlebell overhead

jobs.detail: THREE equal side-by-side panels KETTLEBELL ONE ARM PUSH PRESS. Same FRONT three-quarter view, feet shoulder-width flat in same positions. Exactly ONE gray kettlebell held in model RIGHT hand (IMAGE LEFT) throughout, left hand EMPTY relaxed by side in all panels. Bell arched handle securely enclosed by right hand, round mass outside/back of forearm. LEFT upright standing right bell shoulder rack, elbow underneath load, wrist neutral. MIDDLE shallow knee/hip DIP 15-25degrees, knees track toes, torso upright, bell REMAINS right shoulder rack, no arm press yet. RIGHT drive hips/knees straight then right arm fully overhead, wrist over elbow over right shoulder, round bell behind/outside forearm. No leg re-dip catch, back arch or side bend. Left arm stays unloaded and lowered with empty hand. Primary RIGHT DELTOID red ONLY at loaded shoulder cap, LEFT unloaded shoulder and all triceps/other muscles gray. Shirt solid black no chest tint. Secure closed hand-handle contact, no bell merging or floating. Same feet/person/one bell across all three panels.
jobs.prompt: Correct ONLY red muscle-highlight color placement in this original three-panel male kettlebell single-arm push-press illustration. Preserve ALL poses, grayscale fine anatomical fibers, man/face, bell grip/geometry, camera, opaque black shirt/shorts and white background exactly. In ALL THREE panels: the arm HOLDING kettlebell (on IMAGE LEFT side of each man, model RIGHT arm) is the LOADED arm. Put RED ONLY on that loaded RIGHT DELTOID at shoulder cap, including the small visible shoulder area beside the racked arm. The other arm hanging straight by his side (IMAGE RIGHT of each man, model LEFT arm) is UNLOADED and must be entirely GRAYSCALE, no red whatsoever on its shoulder. REMOVE red from free-arm shoulder in first and middle panels. Keep correct loaded-arm red in last panel. Do not color pectoral shirt, biceps, triceps or neck red, no invented anatomy under shirt. If loaded shoulder partially occluded, color only visible part, not opposite shoulder. No other changes or text.

Press both kettlebells overhead while keeping torso upright

jobs.detail: TWO equal SIDE-BY-SIDE panels KETTLEBELL SEATED PRESS. Same FRONT three-quarter camera. Model sits upright on horizontal padded flat gym BENCH, hips fully supported, knees near90degrees, feet flat shoulder-width on floor. Entire sturdy bench including all support feet/pad shown with white clearance. Exactly TWO matching gray kettlebells per panel, both arched handles securely held in hands, palms facing forward, round masses rest behind/outside forearms. LEFT bells at shoulder height rack, elbows bent below wrists, upright neutral spine/pelvis. RIGHT extend BOTH arms overhead in scapular plane, wrists/elbows stack over shoulders, bells behind/outside forearms; seated hips and feet remain stationary, no standing/leg drive, no lumbar arch or back lean. Neutral wrist and closed secure grips. PRIMARY DELTOIDS exposed red at BOTH shoulder caps only, triceps/pectorals/forearms gray, entire shirt black no tint. Same model, bench, two bells, footwear, lighting and scale across panels. Frame whole bench feet and overhead bells within EACH panel.
